import numpy as np
m, s, p, q = 96, 24, 97, 13
S = build_sketch_operator(m, s, p, q)
residues = {(k * k) % p for k in range(1, p)}
signs0 = np.array([1.0 if (i % p) in residues else -1.0 for i in range(m)], dtype=np.float64)
rows = np.array([(q * k) % m for k in range(s)], dtype=int)

A = construct_kernel_matrix(128, 8)
S = build_sketch_operator(128, 64, 131, 79)

_,_,Vt = np.linalg.svd(S @ A, full_matrices=False)
V_diag = np.array(Vt.T[:, :8], dtype=np.float64)
eps = np.finfo(np.float64).eps
for j in range(8):
    col = V_diag[:, j]
    thr = 10.0 * eps * max(np.linalg.norm(col), 1.0)
    if abs(col[j]) > thr:
        if col[j] < 0.0:
            V_diag[:, j] = -col
    else:
        k = int(np.argmax(np.abs(col)))
        if col[k] < 0.0:

assert np.allclose(float(np.linalg.norm(V - V_diag) > 0.1), target)
